Name: Relationship Editor
Author: ItzMady
Description:
[left][b][size=4]Description[/size][/b][/left]
[left]Relationship Editor is a Stardew Valley mod that allows you to modify relationships with NPCs through SMAPI commands.[/left]
[left]Whether you are testing a custom NPC, developing a mod, fixing a save file, or simply wanting more control over your farm's relationships, this mod provides an easy way to manage friendship data.
[line]
[b][size=4]Why this mod?[/size][/b]
I made this mod because I wanted a simple way to edit friendships without installing an all-in-one cheat menu.
If you only want to change NPC relationships and nothing else, this mod is for you. I may add more features in the future, but for now, the mod focuses only on relationship editing. [/left]
[line]
[size=4][b]Installation + Usage[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI: [url=https://smapi.io/]https://smapi.io/[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]Nexusmods[/url][/*]
[*]Download the latest release of Relationship Editor.[/*]
[*]Extract the mod into your mod folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]If everything is installed correctly, SMAPI should display:
[code][Mady's Relationship Editor] Relationship Editor loaded.[/code]Open the SMAPI console while a game save is running and use:
[code]social help[/code]to display all available commands.
